author: Jake Kanter
title: Apple quietly closed an important privacy loophole while preaching about its data protection credentials (AAPL)
text: Apple quietly closed an important privacy loophole while preaching about its data protection credentials (AAPL) By Jake Kanter Jun 13, 2018, 5:13 am 20 pts Bloomberg reports that Apple has closed a loophole that allowed third-party apps to gather an iPhone user's contacts and potentially sell on the data. The rule change was reportedly made last week and restricts what developers can take and do with contact information. It comes after Apple made a big…
